# The Eclipse Shadow-Fiends — Draft Datasheets

*Owned verb: **HAUNT** · generated by `unit_calculator.py faction` · ×1.5 scale · stat line = MOV · MS · RS · ARM · MIGHT · CTRL*

**Core trait — Ethereal Phase-Form · Wave of Terror:** Ethereal: Eclipse units have no ARM save; instead they have the WARD shown on their datasheet (5+ troops, 4+ elites/Leaders, 5+ for Class 4–5), which no PEN can worsen, and they are [STEALTH] against attacks from more than 12″. Wave of Terror: when an Eclipse unit ends a Charge, pick 1 engaged enemy unit: it gets −1 to Hit in melee until the End of Round.

**Gamble — Phase-Walk** *(risk: exposure)*: When a unit activates: it moves through models and terrain and gets +2″ to its Charge roll this activation, but it loses its WARD until it next activates.

**Army-wide rules (priced into every unit):** *Ethereal: veil* — [STEALTH] beyond 12″. · *Wave of Terror* — −1 to Hit for the charged unit.

## Detachment — Midnight Procession

*Disappear and reappear: the umbra army.*

**Detachment rule:** Vanishing into the Umbra: at the End of Round, pick 1 unengaged Eclipse unit: remove it and set it up anywhere more than 8″ from all enemies.

**Enhancements**
- **Shroud of Midnight** (+15 pts, Phantasm Lord on Spectral Steed): The attached unit is [STEALTH] at all ranges.
- **Void-Lantern** (+10 pts, Lantern-Warden): Units set up by the Umbra within 6″ of him heal D3 MIGHT.

**Stratagems**
- **Fade from Sight** (1 CP) — *A unit is targeted:* It is [STEALTH] at all ranges for the attack.
- **Return from the Umbra** (1 CP) — *A unit is set up by the Umbra:* It may Charge in Round order as if it had moved.
- **Grasp of the Dead** (1 CP) — *An enemy unit Falls Back from an Eclipse unit:* It suffers D3 Fatal Wounds on a 4+.

## Detachment — Soul-Reapers

*Scythes and blades: kill fast before the WARD fails.*

**Detachment rule:** Frightful Touch: Eclipse melee Hit rolls of 6 auto-wound ([IMPALING HITS]).

**Enhancements**
- **Harvester's Scythe** (+15 pts, Knight-Phantasm): +1 Damage on a round he charged.
- **Reaper's Mark** (+30 pts, Eclipse Reapers): Melee Hit rolls of 5+ auto-wound.

**Stratagems**
- **Reap** (1 CP) — *A unit is selected to Fight:* Its melee weapons gain [REAPING 1].
- **Terror Incarnate** (1 CP) — *A unit ends a Charge:* Wave of Terror applies to every engaged enemy unit.
- **Spectral Fury** (1 CP) — *A unit is below Starting Strength:* +1 Attack in melee until the End of Round.

## Detachment — Spectral Host

*The dead keep coming: lanterns, choirs and endless shades.*

**Detachment rule:** Endless Dead: Soul-Tethered Summons can be used twice per round; Void-Shades return D3 slain models at the End of Round within 9″ of a Leader.

**Enhancements**
- **Lantern of Endless Night** (+10 pts, Lantern-Warden): Summons range 12″.
- **Wailing Crown** (+20 pts, Banshee Wailer-Queen): Friendly units within 6″ are [STEALTH] at all ranges.

**Stratagems**
- **Rise Again** (2 CP) — *Command Phase, once per battle:* Return a destroyed Class 1 unit at half strength within 6″ of a Leader.
- **Chill of the Grave** (1 CP) — *An enemy unit within 6″ of a Leader activates:* −1″ to its moves this activation.
- **Wail of the Host** (1 CP) — *A unit is charged:* The charging unit suffers −1 to Hit until the End of Round.
